name: design-orchestrator
description: Unified meta-skill for end-to-end interface and product design in Antigravity
author: alfitocp27 & Antigravity Community

core.name: Core Mode
core.description: Lightweight offline orchestration, project templates, mock validation, zero third-party tool requirement.

full.name: Full Mode
full.description: Full production orchestration with native canvas execution, design intelligence, and codebase memory.

design-orchestrator.description: The unified meta-orchestrator skill managing end-to-end UI/UX product design workflows.

anti-slop.description: Quality guardrail stopping generic AI aesthetic defects (R-01 to R-40).
anti-slop.manualInstructions: Run 'npx antislop-ai --mode during' in the workspace or install via Antigravity plugin manager.

ui-ux-pro-max.description: Design intelligence dataset for palettes, typography scales, and token generation.
ui-ux-pro-max.manualInstructions: Requires Python 3.x. Clone into .agents/skills/ui-ux-pro-max via 'git clone https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill .agents/skills/ui-ux-pro-max'.

impeccable.description: Design craft floor, visual polish, and surface mode direction by Paul Bakaus.
impeccable.manualInstructions: Clone or copy into .agents/skills/impeccable or global skills (~/.gemini/config/skills/impeccable).

figcraft.description: Native FigCraft canvas execution Stdio MCP server for node creation, inspection, and exports.
figcraft.manualInstructions: Install FigCraft desktop app or CLI, and register stdio command 'figcraft-cli mcp' in ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json.

codebase-memory-mcp.description: Codebase memory and graph analysis MCP server.

mobbin_mobbin.description: Mobbin visual screen reference and benchmark exploration MCP server.
mobbin_mobbin.manualInstructions: Install mobbin plugin from Antigravity Plugin Marketplace if real-world mobile/web screenshots are needed.

needmcp.description: Optional cloud MCP design system service providing curated styles and atomic component specs.
needmcp.manualInstructions: Set NEEDMCP_API_KEY environment variable or run 'npx needmcp setup'. Gated: selectStyle only after human sign-off.
